# Monopolises — Evidence-Governed Research Reference

Canonical URL: https://monopolises.com/
Maintainer: Sohadot (https://sohadot.com)
Repository and binding decisions: https://github.com/Sohadot/Monopolises

Current adopted research thesis (DEC-005, 2026-08-29): Layered Monopolisation v0.2.
Unit: System × Layer × Control Mechanism × Evidence.
Four evidenced layer types: legal_exclusivity; capacity_control; access_gatekeeping; switching_dependency.
Research gates: MON-G1-LI PASS; MON-G2-OF PASS; MON-G3-IT PASS; MON-G4-DA PASS.
Evidence scope: eight fixed cases and 17 v0.2 source-register entries (not necessarily 17 independent publications).
Not a live database, monopoly-power verdict, antitrust opinion, ranking, score, or production implementation.

Archive: Strategic Replaceability v0.1 / Replacement Horizon closed Gate MON-G0-RH as FAIL, with five case records retained. It is not the active thesis.
The research cases are dated, scoped, and evidence-bounded. Current-state claims require updated primary verification.
Implementation, scaled or scored surfaces, and monetization remain unauthorized by DEC-008; DEC-009 permits editorial public-state synchronization only.
